scope: Experimental 2-8 simultaneous finite NURBS point constraints, not global or regional fitting
implementation: Cyclic reuse of unchanged targetSurfacePoint; maximum 64 passes; acceptance requires every final residual on one candidate net

checks: sequential targeting can move first contact
duplicates and conflicting UV constraints refused

nativeDraftTest.fixture: Synthetic 20x30x10 imported STEP box, top face refined exactly to 7x7, one manually locked interior pole
nativeDraftTest.transport: Real SurfaceDraft, editor.worker dispatcher and OCCT; simulated worker transport; no host

limitations: No batch UI, current single-target path unchanged
Caller must verify CAD anchors, trim classification, protected poles, source/reference revisions and lifetime before a single commit
Slow or ill-conditioned systems can refuse despite a possible solution
Movement budget is relative to the supplied input net and enforced during every projection
No real scan, global deviation, project persistence, physical pointer or QuickSurface parity qualification
